t2.thesis: While high call skew and a 10% 5-day pre-earnings pullback lower the bar for a relief bounce, massive AI capex run-rates and merger overhang temper upside probability.
reasons: Pre-print de-risking (-9.9% in past 5 days, 30% below highs) and call-heavy options pricing (call IV exceeds put IV by 9.1 points) set a favorable hurdle for an upside surprise.
Massive capital expenditure in the AI segment ($15.8B in Q2 alone) and significant share dilution from the $60B Cursor acquisition closed in August threaten near-term cash burn metrics.
SPCX fell 4.2% at the open following its maiden Q2 earnings report despite a 68.9% EPS beat, illustrating high sell-the-news vulnerability at >80x sales.
t2.deciding_variable: AI segment revenue acceleration and capex guidance relative to Starlink operating cash flow.

prior.from: drones_robotics_space_defense cluster base rate (n=278, win rate 58.6%)

t2.moved_from_prior: Moved down 5.6 percentage points from the cluster base rate of 0.586 to 0.53 due to Q2's negative post-earnings reaction, extreme AI capex spend, and recent Tesla M&A overhang.

theses.expected: Starlink subscriber acceleration and AI Cloud Services revenue beat consensus, spurring a post-earnings relief bounce.
theses.mechanism: Short-term momentum sellers cover following a 10% 5-day drop as top-line growth sustains near 90% YoY.
theses.wrong_if: AI infrastructure capex projections surge well beyond Q2's $15.8B run-rate, triggering free cash flow alarm.

theses.expected: Aggressive AI capex and integration friction from the Cursor acquisition trigger a post-print sell-off.
theses.mechanism: Investors punish heavy cash burn and multiple compression at an 84x P/S valuation despite top-line growth.
theses.wrong_if: Management demonstrates that enterprise Starlink margins and commercial launch cash flows fully fund AI expansion.

theses.expected: Merger commentary surrounding Tesla or regulatory scrutiny mutes market enthusiasm.
theses.mechanism: Speculation regarding complex transaction structures creates equity overhang on SPCX shares.
theses.wrong_if: Musk firmly dispels near-term merger speculation and focuses narrative exclusively on Starship V3 milestones and Grok ARR.

key_observations: Total AI capex reported for Q3 vs Q2's $15.8B baseline
Starlink total ending subscriber count and ARPU trajectory vs Q2's 12.0M and $66
Diluted share count change following the 389M+ shares issued for the Cursor merger
Management commentary on Starship V3 flight schedule and commercial payload backlog
